positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Supporting the development of AI-powered threat detection systems at Doppel by contributing to data quality and research efforts. Helping strengthen defenses against phishing, impersonation, and other forms of AI-driven digital deception.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Web Engineering · Software Industry

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Spearheaded development of a full-stack, AI-powered application leveraging LLMs (GPT, Claude AI) and real-time user feedback to surface expert-specific knowledge from underutilized databases (SQL, Azure) for a $2B+ B2B distributor.
    - Led end-to-end development of: frontend, backend with REST API, data processing pipeline.
    - Currently being live tested with 50+ member sales team with 98%+ accuracy.
    - Demo presented at B2B Online 2024: a conference for top B2B manufacturers and distributors.
• Developed and implemented the company's batch API process to execute agentic calls in batches using OpenAI's batch API; resulted in a 12x improvement in processing speed and cost.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Web Engineering · Large Language Models (LLM) · Software Infrastructure · Agentic AI

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•	Increased the performance of a classifier which finds real estate properties based on client search terms by letting it utilize multiple large language AI models such as ChatGPT and BERT.
•	Devised a ranking system based on identifying components present in images and texts to quantify the performance of above classifier.
positions.insights: Skills: ChatGPT · Data Structures · Software Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Web Application Development · Back-end Operations · Databases · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
•	Created a configurable and fully automated graph neural network (GNN) classifier model which identifies functional logic blocks (adders, muxes, etc.) of different sizes in Verilog to ultimately discover hardware vulnerabilities.
    - Generates and records model information, training and validation metrics and loss graphs over epochs, and test data metrics.
    - Adjusted GNN hyperparameters after researching academic databases to increase accuracy and F1 scores to 0.70.
•	Created similar classifiers using different classification algorithms such as gradient boosted decision trees (GBDT) and LinearSVC.
•	Design and execute experiments to test effects of different hyperparameters on classifier metrics.
    - Discover factors which affect model performances; later experiments were adjusted for these factors.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Structures · Vim · Graph Neural Networks · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning · XGBoost · Databases

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: Create a tree based machine learning classification model that can classify news articles into client-specified taxonomies.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Structures · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Pandas (Software) · Data Analysis · Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning · Regular Expressions · XGBoost · Databases · Linear Algebra · Sentence transformers · Natural Language Processing (NLP)

positions.title: Product Development Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Assisted the product development and operations team in multiple projects:
• Created automated pricing dashboard that calculates average and weighted margins and projected change in revenue for suggested product prices using market data, past sales data, and sales projections. Used dashboard to generate final pricing for new retail good line and new pricing for current personal care line. Presented the dashboard and product pricings to the operations team.
• Competitively researched market prices of national brand and private label products similar to Public Goods’ (PG) products in order to help PG adjust prices effectively and increase margins.
• Contacted product development (PD) firms for Public Goods to partner with based on the firms’ specialties in order to expand PG’s PD capabilities. Presented findings to PD team and identified 2 firms of interest.
• Researched the environmental impacts of silicone vs plastic and created recommendations on when PG should use silicone, biodegradable plastics, or compostable plastics in its products to be environmentally responsible.
• Created reference databases through researching B2B websites on which turnkey manufacturers would be able to most efficiently produce PG products. Included contact information, manufacturing capabilities, and certifications for the PD department to utilize.

positions.title: Microbiology Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Independently quantified and compared rates of a novel metabolic process among 28 different lactic acid bacteria strains via colorimetric assays.
•	Interpreted BLAST-sequenced gene and protein data via Microsoft Excel and identified potential metabolic pathways in lactic acid bacteria.
•	Wrote a journal quality research paper and presented findings to over 100 peers and faculty at a research symposium.

company.name: Marco Lab at the University of California Davis

positions.title: Food Science Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Researched the potential for cafestol, a coffee bioactive, to treat obesity in humans using C. elegans as an animal model. Measured effects of cafestol on C. elegans in relation to traits such as triglyceride levels.
•	Treated C. elegans knockout mutants with cafestol to identify potential pathways by which cafestol may reduce triglyceride levels.
•	Presented findings to UMass faculty at a research symposium. Results were published in Food Chemistry: Farias-Pereira, R., Kim, E., & Park, Y. (2020). Cafestol increases fat oxidation and energy expenditure in Caenorhabditis elegans via DAF-12-dependent pathway. Food Chemistry, 307, 1-8. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.foodchem.2019.125537.
